description: This file contains extension methods for managing content type and part definitions, including migration of settings and listing widget types, within the OrchardCore CMS framework.

classes.name: ContentDefinitionManagerExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for content definition management, including modification, migration, and listing of content types and parts.

methods.name: AlterTypeDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Modifies or creates a content type definition asynchronously using a builder or an alteration function.

methods.name: AlterPartDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Modifies or creates a content part definition asynchronously using a builder or an alteration function.

methods.name: MigratePartSettingsAsync
methods.description: Migrates existing ContentPart settings to use WithSettings<T> for a specified part type.

methods.name: MigrateFieldSettingsAsync
methods.description: Migrates existing ContentField settings to use WithSettings<T> for a specified field type.

methods.name: ListWidgetTypeDefinitionsAsync
methods.description: Returns all content type definitions that have the stereotype 'Widget'.
